text:
Complete phosphocreatine resynthesis after very high-intensity exercise normally takes a few minutes, about 3–5 minutes for essentially full restoration. Recovery is exponential, with a half-time near 30 seconds, so most of the store returns in the first minute and the remainder needs several more half-times; when acidosis slows the process, full repletion can stretch toward about 8 minutes.

CONFIDENCE: 80
